notes: «أبو عبد الرحمن» is written as it stands (ruling 3); «لفظا» is a transmission word, not a name
«أمرني عبد الرحمن بن أبزى أن أسأل ابن عباس» : the one who gives the order is in the scene, not a link (rule 6); Ibn Abbas is the one asked and answers («فسألته فقال»)
«وعن هذه الآية» continues the same chain to a second verse with the same answerer, so no new route is written
